lede: The biggest item this week is a joint work session Thursday where the San Miguel County Planning Commission and Board of County Commissioners dig into proposed Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil and gas, condominium plats, and deep geothermal operations — no final votes, but this is where the shape of those rules gets decided. Monday the Open Space Commission takes up three trail alignment options for Valley Floor Reach 1, threading around wetland delineations, plus a Telluride Mountain Club request to route a quarter-mile of trail through the open space. Wednesday the commissioners travel to Norwood for a rare West End meeting that includes a Planning Commission appointment and a Placerville Fire Survey presentation.

notable.stake: Commission chooses Valley Floor trail routes and rules on Mountain Club access request.
Commissioners appoint alternate Planning Commission member, affecting future land-use votes.
County land use code rewrites on forestry, oil/gas, geothermal, and condos take shape here.
